preconditions.description: The number of photos on the widget, n, is between 3 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of albums, m, is between 1 and 40 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 1000 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each album contains between 1 and 1000 photos inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(result) == n and all(1 <= ti <= m for ti in result))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' indicating no solution, or a list of n album numbers where each number is between 1 and m inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(result[i] != result[(i + 1) % n] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If there is a solution, no two consecutive photos in the cyclic sequence are from the same album.
